description_en: Creates a ticket for changing data in Data Management (DMS)
description_zh: 创建普通数据变更工单
name: CreateDataCorrectOrder

parameters.help_en: The purpose or objective of the data change. This parameter is used to help reduce unnecessary communication
parameters.help_zh: 业务背景，以减少沟通成本
parameters.name: comment

parameters.help_en: The stakeholders of the data change. All stakeholders can view the ticket details and assist in the approval process. Irrelevant users other than DMS administrators and database administrators (DBAs) are not allowed to view the ticket details
parameters.name: related_user_list

fields.help_en:
The key of the attachment that contains the SQL statements used to change data. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206069.html operation to obtain the attachment key from the value of AttachmentKey.

This parameter is required if you set SqlType to ATTACHMENT
fields.help_zh:
变更SQL附件Key（AttachmentKey），可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206069.html接口获取该参数的值。

如果SqlType为ATTACHMENT，该参数必填
fields.name: attachment_name

fields.help_en: The reason for the data change
fields.name: classify

fields.help_en:
The database ID. The database can be a physical database or a logical database.

To query the ID of a physical database, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html operation.
To query the ID of a logical database, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141874.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html operation
fields.help_zh:
数据库ID（DatabaseId）。数据库分为物理库和逻辑库两种：
物理库ID：调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html接口获取该参数的值。

逻辑库ID：调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141874.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html接口获取该参数的值
fields.name: db_id

fields.help_en:
The instance ID. You can call the ListInstances or GetInstance operation to query the instance ID.


The instance change feature is supported only by ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instances, PolarDB for MySQL clusters, and AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters
fields.help_zh:
实例ID。您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141936.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141567.html接口获取该参数的值。

目前实例的变更仅支持选择如下类型的MySQL实例：RDS MySQL、PolarDB MySQL版和AnalyticDB for MySQL
fields.name: instance_id

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether the database is a logical database. Valid values:

true: The database is a logical database.
false: The database is a physical database
fields.help_zh:
是否为逻辑库，取值如下：
true：逻辑库
false：物理库
fields.name: logic

fields.help_en: The databases whose data you want to change
fields.help_zh: 变更的数据库或实例列表
fields.name: db_item_list

fields.help_en: The estimated number of data rows that may be affected by the data change
fields.help_zh: 预估本次变更会影响的数据行数
fields.name: estimate_affect_rows

fields.help_en:
The mode in which the data change ticket is executed after the ticket is approved. Valid values:

COMMITOR: The ticket is executed by the user who submits the ticket.
AUTO: The ticket is automatically executed after the ticket is approved.
LAST_AUDITOR: The ticket is executed by the last approver of the ticket
fields.help_zh:
工单执行方式，取值如下：

COMMITOR : 审批通过后，提交者执行。
AUTO : 审批通过后，自动执行。
LAST_AUDITOR : 审批通过后，最后一个审批人执行
fields.name: exec_mode

fields.example: update base_user set id = 1 where id  = 1;
fields.help_en:
The SQL statements for data change.



This parameter is required if you set SqlType to TEXT.

The size of the SQL statement cannot exceed 15 MB
fields.help_zh:
变更SQL语句。

如果SqlType为TEXT，该参数必填。
SQL代码大小不能超过1 KB
fields.name: exec_sql

fields.help_en:
The key of the attachment that contains the SQL statements used to roll back the data change. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206069.html operation to obtain the attachment key from the value of AttachmentKey.

This parameter is required if you set RollbackSqlType to ATTACHMENT
fields.help_zh:
回滚SQL附件Key（AttachmentKey），可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206069.html接口获取该参数的值。

如果RollbackSqlType为ATTACHMENT，该参数必填
fields.name: rollback_attachment_name

fields.example: update base_user set id = 1 where id  = 1;
fields.help_en:
The SQL statements for rolling back the data change.

This parameter is required if you set RollbackSqlType to TEXT
fields.help_zh:
回滚SQL语句。
如果RollbackSqlType为TEXT，该参数必填
fields.name: rollback_sql

fields.help_en:
The format of the SQL statements used to roll back the data change. Valid values:

TEXT
ATTACHMENT
fields.help_zh:
回滚SQL的提交方式，取值如下：
TEXT：文本
ATTACHMENT：附件
fields.name: rollback_sql_type

fields.help_en:
The format of the SQL statements used to change data. Valid values:

TEXT
ATTACHMENT
fields.help_zh:
变更SQL的提交方式，取值如下：
TEXT：文本。
ATTACHMENT：附件。

如果您选择文本方式，则SQL代码大小不能超过1 KB。如果SQL代码超过1 KB，建议您选择上传附件的方式
fields.name: sql_type

parameters.help_en: The key of the attachment that provides more instructions for the ticket. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206069.html operation to obtain the attachment key from the value of the AttachmentKey parameter
parameters.help_zh: 工单附件Key，补充当前工单信息。可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206069.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: attachment_key

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that is used to call the API operation
parameters.help_zh: 实际调用API的用户的阿里云账号UID
parameters.name: real_login_user_uid

parameters.help_en: The ID of the tenant. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html operation to obtain the tenant ID
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: tid

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned if the request fails

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the request fails

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:

true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败
